name: forgeops-platform-typescript
description: TypeScript sources for PingIDM custom endpoints and PingAM scripted nodes. Compiled to ES5 and emitted into platform/idm/script and platform/idm/conf.

scripts.check: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.am.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
